```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)

```


## Plot colors
```{r colors and order, include=FALSE}
treat.colors <- c("control"  = "darkseagreen" , "chicken"= "royalblue1", "cow" = "red3","pellet"= "darkorchid1","compost"="chocolate4")

time.colors <- c("#BFD3E6", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C")


treat.order  <- c("control",  "chicken", "cow","compost", "pellet")
treat.labels <- c("Control",  "Chicken\nmanure", "Cow\nmanure","Compost", "Pelletised\ncompost")

treat.colors_ok <- c("Control"  = "darkseagreen" , "Chicken\nmanure"= "royalblue1", "Cow\nmanure" = "red3","Pelletised\ncompost"= "darkorchid1","Compost"="chocolate4")
```

## Load data

```{r}
zotu97 <- import_qiime("../01_Raw_data/p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")

metadata <- read.csv("../01_Raw_data/metadata_2025.csv" ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var= "sample_name")
metadata$treat.pot <- paste(metadata$treatment, metadata$rep, sep= "_")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))


```


## Alpha indexes

```{r}
richness <- specnumber(otu_table(zotu97), MARGIN=2)

shannon <- diversity(otu_table(zotu97), MARGIN= 2)

evenness <- shannon/richness

div.index <- data.frame(cbind(richness, shannon, evenness))

sample_table<- cbind(sample_data(zotu97), div.index)

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(sample_table))

sample_data(zotu97)
```

### Check indexes normality


```{r normality-shannon}
sample_table %>% 
  shapiro_test(shannon)

ggqqplot(data=sample_table, "shannon", facet.by= "time")

# The outliers are accounted for due to their low sequencing depth as seen in 01_introduction


sample_table %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  shapiro_test(shannon)

ggqqplot(data=sample_table, "shannon", facet.by= "treatment")
# Same as above
```

```{r normality-evenness}
sample_table %>% 
  shapiro_test(evenness)

ggqqplot(data=sample_table, "evenness", facet.by= "time")

# The outliers are accounted for due to their low sequencing depth as seen in 01_introduction


sample_table %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  shapiro_test(evenness)

ggqqplot(data=sample_table, "evenness", facet.by= "treatment")
# Same as above
```

```{r normality-richness}
sample_table %>% 
  shapiro_test(richness)

ggqqplot(data=sample_table, "richness", facet.by= "time")

# The outliers are accounted for due to their low sequencing depth as seen in 01_introduction


sample_table %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  shapiro_test(richness)

ggqqplot(data=sample_table, "richness", facet.by= "treatment")
# Same as above
```

## Alpha diversity stats

```{r}
sample_table <- sample_table %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treat.order))
sample_table
```

```{r model-shannon}
lmer.shannon <- lmer(shannon ~ time*treatment+(1|treat.pot) , data = sample_table)
summary(lmer.shannon)

#Repeated measures anova
anova.shannon <- anova(lmer.shannon) %>% as.data.frame()
emm_time_by_trt <- emmeans(lmer.shannon, ~ time | treatment) %>%
  as.data.frame()

shannon_treat_facet <- sample_table %>% ggplot(aes(x= time, y= shannon, color= treatment, group = treat.pot)) +
  geom_point(shape= 4) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
 geom_point(data = emm_time_by_trt,
             aes(x = time, y = emmean, color = treatment, group = treatment),
             inherit.aes = FALSE,
             size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(data = emm_time_by_trt,
          aes(time, emmean, color = treatment, group = treatment),
          inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values= treat.colors)+
  facet_wrap(~factor(treatment, levels = treat.order, labels = treat.labels),
             nrow = 1) +
  xlab(NULL)+ylab("Shannon index")+
  theme_light() +
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    strip.placement   = "outside",
    strip.text.x.top  = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.spacing.x   = unit(0.1, "lines"), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),   # legend size
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.3)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend("Taxonomy", nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
  
shannon_treat_facet

ggsave(shannon_treat_facet, file= "../04_Figures/Supplemetary_FigureS4AITS.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(shannon_treat_facet, file = '../03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplementary_FigureS4AITS.rds')

```
